items.title: Record canonical noninteractive launcher readiness per review host
items.context: Extend host availability proof beyond binary/version presence. Each canonical host row should report the launcher shape used for reviewer work, whether the CLI supports it, whether a bounded smoke can start/finish or produce first progress, and a failureKind for auth, wrong flags, timeout, missing executable, or silent-final-output only.
items.userSees: Probe JSON includes "host=claude-code executionReady=true reviewReady=true progressMode=stream-json failureKind=none" and failed rows such as "host=codex executionReady=false reviewReady=false failureKind=auth" with bounded firstProgressMs/durationMs and no raw transcript.

happy.desc: review_host_availability_probe records per-host launcher readiness rows for codex, claude, and agy including launcher argv, executionReady/reviewReady, progressMode, failureKind, firstProgressMs or durationMs, and no raw provider transcript.

edge.desc: A host with executable path and versionOk=true but noninteractive launcher/auth failure remains available=true but executionReady=false/reviewReady=false with a specific failureKind.

adversarial.desc: Forged or contradictory readiness counts are rejected: reviewReadyHostCount must match host rows and retired completion fields must remain false.

verificationEvidence.note: Readiness smoke verified canonical codex/claude/agy rows include launcherArgv, executionReady/reviewReady, progressMode, failureKind, bounded timing fields, and no raw transcript fields.
Smoke classified codex exec refresh_token_invalidated as failureKind=auth with executionReady=false/reviewReady=false despite version-capable executable assumptions.
Smoke rejects legacy/contradictory readiness probes; process fact contract requires host-readiness semantics and reviewReadyHostCount in gate evidence.

items.title: Use execution-ready host counts for degraded fallback and host dispatch diagnostics
items.context: Non-human degraded fallback must not be eligible just because two hosts fail launcher/auth readiness after passing --version. The gate should distinguish availableHostCount from reviewReadyHostCount/executionReadyHostCount and explain when Codex token invalidation, Claude silent mode, or agy wrong flags require full 3x2 remediation or explicit-human-approval.
items.userSees: Fallback diagnostics include "reviewReadyHostCount=1 below required=2; degraded fallback remains lower-assurance" when only one host is review-ready, and "refusing single-host-environment: reviewReadyHostCount=2" when two independent hosts can run.

happy.desc: Non-human degraded fallback accepts only when a fresh current-material probe shows reviewReadyHostCount below two and records lower assurance diagnostics.

edge.desc: Legacy B-7438-style probes without readiness fields do not silently satisfy review-ready proof for non-human degraded fallback; diagnostics explain to rerun the stronger probe or use explicit-human-approval.

adversarial.desc: If two or more canonical hosts are review-ready, single-host-environment and temporary-host-unavailability fallback are refused even when version-only availability data or prose evidenceRefs claim otherwise.

verificationEvidence.note: Fresh current-HEAD transcript evidence: observed smoke output includes reviewReadyHostCount below two permitting degraded 3x1 and two review-ready canonical hosts blocking single-host fallback for both escalation and assurance floor gates.
Legacy version-only probe records are rejected for non-human fallback and diagnostics require rerunning the v2 readiness probe or using explicit-human-approval.
Fallback is refused when two canonical hosts are reviewReady even if single-host-environment or temporary-host-unavailability is claimed.

Observed smoke output included probe with reviewReadyHostCount below two permits degraded 3x1 and probe with two executable canonical hosts blocks single-host fallback for both escalation and assurance floor paths.

items.title: Cover Claude stream-json verbose, Codex exec auth, and agy print launcher with smoke tests
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage that proves Claude observable launcher is claude --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json, plain --print is classified as silent/non-progress for long reviewer work, agy --prompt-file is rejected while agy --print/--print-timeout is canonical, and Codex version/login without codex exec success is not review-ready.
items.userSees: Smoke output prints "PASS claude launcher uses --print --verbose --output-format stream-json", "PASS agy --prompt-file classified wrong_launcher", and "PASS codex exec token_invalidated classified auth".

happy.desc: Smoke tests prove Claude observable reviewer launcher includes --print --verbose --output-format=stream-json and reports progress-capable mode.

edge.desc: Smoke tests prove agy --prompt-file is classified as wrong_launcher while agy --print with --print-timeout is the canonical noninteractive launcher.

adversarial.desc: Smoke tests prove Codex can pass version/login checks but fail codex exec with token_invalidated/refresh_token_invalidated, and that state is classified as auth failure rather than review-ready.

verificationEvidence.note: Readiness smoke proves canonical Claude launcher uses --print --verbose --output-format stream-json and dispatch smoke verifies claude invocationTemplate starts with that observable launcher.
Smoke classifies agy --prompt-file as wrong_launcher while dispatch scaffolding uses agy --print with --print-timeout and no --prompt-file.
Smoke proves codex exec token_invalidated/refresh_token_invalidated output is classified as failureKind=auth with reviewReady=false, rather than counting version/login as executable review readiness.
